maria (growth): short thread 1: need a compact benchmark hero for the launch: latency vs unit-cost + one mobile chart. owners?
tejas (marketing): i'll own the experiment wiring + copy. keep hero simple so it fits social card.
olivia (design): plan: 3-panel desktop (p50/p95 sparkline, cost/1k stacked, throughput heatmap) + 1 skinny mobile. i'll mock tonight.
samir (pm): data source = latest v2-opt + quant runs. i'll drop a trimmed CSV to /bench/2026-03/hero.csv and flag cold/warm cache rows.
lee (analytics): quick check: hosted p50 ~80ms; hosted cost ~ $0.020/1k; dedicated quant ~ $0.006/1k. we can say "significantly lower unit cost on dedicated configs" + footnote.
nina (content): CTA variants to AB test: "Start free" vs "See savings". hero one-liner options: 1) "Predictable LLM inference with clear unit economics." 2) "Fast p50s. Lower per-token costs."
maria (growth): routing rule: trial signups >100k tokens/mo OR est spend >$2k -> AE handoff. nina add to doc.
olivia (design): placeholder heatmap for layout:
```
seq_len,batch,throughput
128,8,330
```

tejas (marketing): timeline: mock Thu, copy Fri, review Mon, experiment Wed. owners: olivia design, nina copy, samir data, lee analytics, tejas experiment, maria launch.
maria (growth): one tiny ask: avoid absolute "4x" hero claim. use "up to" in secondary callout with qualifier. will schedule sign-off Mon. :calendar: :rocket:
